decision: Study the relation between violence and Saber 11 results by DANE municipality.
reason: The research goal stated in the README; the APIs had never been connected.

decision: Keep Galtung's dimensions (physical, cultural, structural) plus gender, each as a composite index combined by geometric mean as in the UNDP Human Development Index.
reason: The logic of the original model; the geometric mean is already validated.

decision: Students' answers never enter an index.
reason: Avoid circularity: what the students report is set beside the census, not used to measure the municipality.

decision: Separate the schema: one schema per dimension and level.
reason: The original model had problems of writing; separating makes each part readable.

decision: Compare governments in the long term: Uribe I and II, Santos I and II, Duque, Petro (2002-2026); Santos II split at the signing of the peace agreement (2016-11-24).
reason: The researcher asked for the long-term comparison; the split of Santos II separates negotiation from implementation.

decision: Recover massacres from press, secondary and judicial sources; add INDEPAZ and triangulate it with CNMH and Police.
reason: Massacres are documented even without official records.

decision: Drop Bourdieu's cultural capital. Symmetric sociology: the exam as an operator that opens or closes spaces of possibility, violence as a material effect; Marx as a possible point of arrival, not of departure. A description of the map.
reason: Bourdieu's frame was uncomfortable and explained in advance what should be described.

decision: Local MariaDB; Saber 11 at student level; DataIcfes through the browser, left for last.
reason: The student questionnaire is the real data of each student; DataIcfes was blocked.

decision: Every source is joined by the five-digit DANE code, never by names.
reason: Names change spelling between sources; codes do not.

decision: Two massacre records are the same event when they share municipality and are at most 3 days apart (15 when the date has only the month), matched one to one by nearest date.
reason: The triangulation rule.

decision: Run the Saber 11 microdata load again in full.
reason: School names, sector and area were missing.

decision: Cleaning and production of the data come first. Where there is no global score, it is the simple mean of the tests.
reason: Before 2014-2 ICFES published no global score.

decision: A test written as -1 is NULL; an exam with every test at 0 was not taken and its scores are NULL.
reason: The files mark unscored tests that way.

decision: Atypical values are annotated per municipality and column. Errors are not used; values that are atypical only because of a small base are smoothed by empirical Bayes; real extremes are kept.
reason: The researcher proposed replacing outliers by the median; the assistant objected that the extremes are the violence under study; the researcher chose this rule.

decision: Each source is reviewed on its own terms, as the validation step of a normal ETL.
reason: One rule for all sources flagged most conflict municipalities as anomalies.

decision: Data that depend on the municipality (DANE above all) are reviewed first; Medicina Legal is included with less priority.
Dense measures are judged by robust z after smoothing; sparse counts by the Poisson probability at the rate of the municipality's peer group.
reason: With most municipalities at zero, a robust z flags every municipality with one event.

decision: Municipalities are compared with their peers, and smoothed toward them: the peer group is DNP's rurality category.
reason: Comparing apples with apples; the department mixes cities with dispersed rural areas.

decision: Keep collecting before fixing the research question; the exploratory analysis sets the variables, the studies and the questions.
reason: Collecting everything was limited by human capacity, which is no longer the constraint.

decision: Declared objective: analyse the relation between violence, in its forms, structural violence included, and the results of the Saber exams, in the frame of conflict, negotiation, post-conflict and alternative governments. The researcher's hypothesis (violence as material base of the results) is not declared: it is to be tested.
reason: The declared objective cannot be the researcher's hypothesis.

decision: The material conditions of each municipality include the money that reaches it: DNP TerriData and the budget execution reported to the CGN (CUIPO).
Municipal GDP and Gini are read together, not separately.
Estimate a municipal income Gini from the Saber 11 family income brackets (2009-2 to 2016-2) and check it against DANE's departmental and city Gini.
reason: There is no municipal Gini series; the researcher asked to estimate it with what there is and check it by department.

decision: No garbage in: every new source enters normalized and validated; what fails its rules does not reach the model.

Split municipalities: a lineage table (mother, daughter, year) and two readings of every series, the territory as it was each year and a constant territory (mother plus daughter), instead of filling earlier years with a median or mean.
reason: Proposed by the assistant after the researcher raised the problem and suggested the median or the mean of earlier years; confirmed by the researcher on 2026-11-13.

decision: Municipalities certified in education are analysed apart from those that are not: education is analysed from its administrative structure.
reason: A certified entity hires, contracts and sets local rules for its schools.

decision: Analyse the State's action through the norm and the administration: who is responsible and how far, which objectives (desired future states with resources assigned), and which socially relevant problems (an uncomfortable fact plus its explanation). What is absent from the agenda is a decision, not an oversight.
reason: The relation between violence and education passes through the State's capacity to act.

decision: Group municipalities by similarity (clustering) and review the norms in two or three representative cases of each group.
reason: The norm barely varies between municipalities; the cases show the administrative logic.

decision: Third normal form at least; every connection between two things is its own table in fourth normal form; norms are kept literally; the State's entities are a table of their own, and schools are entities.
reason: The model is getting complex; without order it collapses.

decision: Keep a decision log inside the model.
reason: The AI-assisted method has to be defensible: who decided what and why.

decision: Gender is an axis that runs through every form of violence and every outcome, not a type of violence: every measure is broken down by sex where the source allows it. Reported partner and sexual violence are kept as a measure of reporting, not of prevalence.
reason: Reported gender violence depends on the presence of institutions that receive the complaint, which moves with rurality, conflict and state presence; its separation as a dimension had a theoretical, not an empirical, justification.

decision: No type of violence is imposed in advance. The axes along which violence and conditions vary are found in the data during the exploratory analysis and named afterwards. Galtung's dimensions and their indices stay in the model only as a theoretical benchmark to compare with what the data show.
reason: Structural violence presumes decisions that lead to a given state, which is what the project measures: it is a possible point of arrival, not a starting category. The data may show other structures (motley, overlapping ones, as in Medellin).
